name: Install F-Droid (open-source app store)
summary: Installs F-Droid, the open-source app store, from an APK you downloaded from its official site. reclaim installs it; it never downloads anything.
notes: Get the APK from https://f-droid.org, then: reclaim run androidtv/install-fdroid --apk /path/to.apk --yes
